run_laikago_ars_training: run the ARS training script for the Laikago quadruped robot using command line arguments
create_laikago_env: create a Laikago environment with GIN configuration files for forward locomotion tasks
run_worker_rollouts: run parallel rollouts with positive and negative policy perturbations using the Worker class
train_ars_policy: train a linear or neural network policy using the ARSLearner augmented random search algorithm
aggregate_rollouts: aggregate parallel rollout results to compute the gradient estimate for policy weight updates
